notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI implements the NPC-session range guard for two of the session kinds: the vendor window closes when the vendor despawns or moves beyond 5.5556 yd (Program.Vendor.Session.cs UpdateVendorLifecycle) and the quest-NPC panels close on despawn/death/range (Program.Quest.cs UpdateQuestNpcLifecycle), both with the close sound. Vendor-to-vendor switch also reproduces the close-then-open double-sound law (OpenVendorSession).
